senses.sense_definition: de mate waarin iets lastig of zwaar is om te doen of te begrijpen

examples.text: De <w>moeilijkheid</w> van dit examen was veel groter dan we hadden verwacht.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>difficulty</w> of this exam was much greater than we had expected.
target_lang_translations.it: La <w>difficoltà</w> di questo esame è stata molto maggiore di quanto ci aspettassimo.

examples.text: Ondanks de grote <w>moeilijkheid</w> van de opdracht wist hij een goed resultaat te behalen.

target_lang_translations.en: Despite the great <w>difficulty</w> of the assignment, he managed to achieve a good result.
target_lang_translations.it: Nonostante la grande <w>difficoltà</w> del compito, è riuscito a ottenere un buon risultato.

target_lang_definitions.en: the degree to which something is hard or heavy to do or understand
target_lang_definitions.it: il grado in cui qualcosa è difficile, faticoso o complesso da fare o da capire

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: the state of being hard to do
the level of intricacy or difficulty in understanding

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: la qualità o il grado di ciò che è difficile
il livello di complicazione o intrigatezza

senses.sense_definition: een concreet probleem of een lastige situatie

examples.text: Ik heb je toch niet in <w>moeilijkheden</w> gebracht door te laat te komen?

target_lang_translations.en: I didn't get you into <w>trouble</w> by arriving late, did I?
target_lang_translations.it: Non ti ho mica messo nei <w>guai</w> arrivando in ritardo?

examples.text: Hij probeert altijd een oplossing te vinden voor elke <w>moeilijkheid</w> die hij tegenkomt.

target_lang_translations.en: He always tries to find a solution for every <w>difficulty</w> he encounters.
target_lang_translations.it: Cerca sempre di trovare una soluzione per ogni <w>difficoltà</w> che incontra.

target_lang_definitions.en: a concrete problem or a troublesome situation
target_lang_definitions.it: un problema concreto, un ostacolo o una situazione critica

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: a specific matter that needs to be dealt with

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: questione critica o complicazione da risolvere
